resources.string: Touch, or the D-pad and A. B goes back.

Choose the .nds file you dumped from your own 358/2 Days cartridge. The European and the North American release both work. Copy the file onto this device first, with a USB cable or an SD card; any folder will do.
Not enough free space: the game needs %1$s, and this device has %2$s free.
The HD cutscenes and the HD menus and HUD are pulled from your own copies of KINGDOM HEARTS HD 1.5+2.5 ReMIX and 2.8, on a Windows PC, then copied here:
1. On a Windows PC where KINGDOM HEARTS HD 1.5+2.5 ReMIX is installed (Steam or Epic), download the KH 358/2 Days Port installer: github.com/Yokimitsuro/khdays-port/releases
2. Run it. When it asks for your ROM, give it the same .nds file. Tick HD videos. Tick HD menus as well if you also have KINGDOM HEARTS HD 2.8 Final Chapter Prologue.

3. When it is done, copy the folder it installed to onto this device, with a USB cable or an SD card. The whole folder is fine (only its data\\cutscenes and mods folders are used). Any folder on this device will do, such as Download.
4. Choose that folder here. The HD files are copied in and turned on.
HD menus and HUD: not added
No HD files in that folder. Choose the folder the PC installer installed to (it holds data\\cutscenes or mods\\HD PACK), or a folder it is in.
Everything in that folder is already here.

The HD cutscenes take about 6 GB. You can keep them in a folder of your own instead, such as one on a memory card: the game reads them from that folder\'s data\\cutscenes (the PC installer\'s folder, copied whole, can be chosen as it is) or from its cutscenes folder, and HD files added above go there too. Android asks you to allow this app access to all files first.
Keep the HD files in a folder of my own
The HD cutscenes are read from %1$s from the next time the game starts. If it is running now, close it from the recent apps and start it again.
The HD cutscenes are read from the app\'s folder again from the next time the game starts.

A mod is a folder; put it in the mods folder named above, with a file manager or a USB cable. Each mod is turned on and off in the game, in Settings > Mods, and a mod is also off while its folder holds a file named .ignore. You can keep the mods in a folder of your own instead, such as one on a memory card: choose the folder that holds the mods themselves. Android asks you to allow this app access to all files first.
Use a mods folder of my own
The mods are read from %1$s from the next time the game starts. If it is running now, close it from the recent apps and start it again.
The mods are read from the app\'s folder again from the next time the game starts.
Chosen: %1$s, but it cannot be read now (the memory card is out, or access to all files is not allowed). The app\'s folder is used meanwhile.
The game cannot open that folder. Choose a folder on this device\'s storage or its memory card, not a cloud folder or a Downloads shortcut.
